crossRefs.note: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.

people.name: Appaim
people.line: Son of Nadab, descendant of Judah

people.name: Nadab
people.line: Son of Shammai, from the tribe of Judah.

people.name: Seled
people.line: Son of Nadab, died without children

translations.web: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; but Seled died without children.
translations.bsb: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim. Seled died without children.
translations.kjv: And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim: but Seled died without children.
translations.asv: And the sons of Nadab: Seled, and Appaim; but Seled died without children.
